name: Dispel Magic
classes: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
summary: End spells on a creature, object, or magical effect.
description: Choose one creature, object, or effect. Spells of 3rd or lower end. Higher: check DC 10 + spell level for each.
higherLevels: Auto-ends spells of equal or lower level than the slot used.
